decision.summary: target-b has a 100% error rate and ~5s p95 latency while target-a is healthy. Configurations are identical, container is running, and both workers pass the visible tool-call canary. The root cause is target-b being stuck in a serving state with degraded performance despite correct configuration. The immediate issue appears to be target-b serving errors that route-probe detects (error_rate 1.0 in initial snapshot).

repair_plan.expected_effect: Relaunches target-b worker with its current profile, clearing any transient serving degradation while preserving its configuration.
repair_plan.risk: Low - restart-worker is a safe, reversible action; target-b will be briefly unavailable but target-a continues serving. Requires rollback via undrain-worker if issues persist.
verification_plan: Run route-probe to confirm target-b error_rate drops to 0.0 and p95_s returns below 0.5s
Run tool-call-visible on target-b to verify structured tool-call canary passes post-restart
repair_plan.rollback_plan: Apply undrain-worker to return target-b to rotation after confirming health, or re-apply restart-worker if error_rate remains elevated.
